mapper.select: select tree_id, species, grade, chest, survey_id, survey_date,u.username,latitude,longitude, ST_AsText(geom) as geomText, ST_Distance(d.geom::geography,ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude},#{latitude}),4326)::geography) as distance from diseased_trees d left join users u on d.survey_id = u.user_id where ST_DWithin(d.geom::geography,ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude},#{latitude}),4326)::geography,#{radius}) order by distance

SELECT tree_id, species, grade, chest, survey_id, survey_date, longitude, latitude FROM diseased_trees where tree_id IN
#{id}
